 Tesla Earnings Mixed; Elon Musk Looms With SpaceX, Robotaxi, Optimus In Focus (Live Coverage) 
 Licensing 
 PAOLO CONFINO 
 Updated 04:37 PM ET 10/21/2026
 Tesla reported better-than-expected earnings late Wednesday, but revenue fell just short. As usual, investor attention will be on Elon Musk and the post-earnings call. Capital spending plans, robotaxi efforts, Optimus delays and a possible SpaceX merger will be in focus. Tesla stock rose slightly in late trade, nearing a trendline entry above the 200-day line. Shares gained 3.4% to 386.50…
